title: A present for Dad
instructions: İki kardeş babaları için hediye seçiyor. Uzun bir diyalog; reddedilen fikirleri ve son kararı takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: Tim, it's Dad's birthday next Sunday. What can we buy him?

script.speaker: tim
script.text: What about a book? He likes reading.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: We gave him a book last year. Something different.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: No, Mum always buys him shirts. What about a watch? His old watch is broken.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: Watches are very expensive. I have only twenty pounds.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: I have thirty. So we have fifty pounds.

script.speaker: tim
script.text: That's OK for a simple watch. Let's go to the shop on Saturday morning.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: Good idea. And we can make a cake too. Dad loves chocolate cake.

script.speaker: eva
script.text: Don't worry. I can make it.

questions.prompt: Why don't they buy a book?
options: They gave him a book last year.
He has a lot of books.
questions.evidence: We gave him a book last year.

questions.prompt: What are they going to buy?
How much money do they have together?
questions.feedback: Tim'in yirmi, Eva'nın otuz poundu var: toplam elli.

questions.prompt: Who is going to make the cake?
questions.feedback: Tim yemek yapamıyor; pastayı Eva yapacak.
questions.evidence: Don't worry. I can make it.
